pro.notes: Right-click now works anywhere on the window - that is where the update-check switch lives. Failed preset saves are reported instead of being silent, damaged preset files are moved aside instead of overwritten, and presets made in the free edition are carried over. The update notice is now a card. The sound is bit-identical to 1.0.0.
